quotes.text: Promotion must recheck allowed branch/detached state, HEAD, cleanliness, ancestry, and collisions; never overwrite untracked or ignored files. Retain/report partial promotion with `updatedSources`, rather than resetting already-promoted checkouts. The final suite had 27 passing dependency-update tests, ESLint/diff checks and independent review passed. [Task 1]
